title: NVIDIA reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and board director
summary: NVIDIA announced that its board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and a director, effective immediately. Colette Kress continues as CFO and Harvey Jones remains board chair. The independent investigation continues; the company also describes an export-control oversight committee and a search for a chief compliance officer. This updates the leadership position reported in the November 12 news entry. It does not establish a change in chip output or supply capacity.

title: Analog Devices reports fiscal 2026 results and first-quarter outlook
summary: Analog Devices reports fourth-quarter revenue of $4.37 billion and fiscal 2026 revenue of $15.2 billion, up 38% year on year, for the year ended October 31. Management forecasts first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $4.4 billion, plus or minus $150 million. The outlook is forward-looking; financial growth does not by itself quantify physical semiconductor output or a supply disruption.
